source_quote: This interface is only called as an internal interface. Please add a "_" before the interface.

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha c04f7f4 体现修改

rule.description: 仅作为内部使用的接口/方法应使用下划线 `_` 前缀命名，以符合 Python 的命名约定，明确表示该接口不应用于外部调用。
checkpoints: 检查仅在模块/类内部调用的方法是否使用了 `_` 前缀
确认公共接口和内部接口的命名有明确区分

                sfa_impl, ql_nope, q_pe, kv, block_table,

                actual_seq_lengths_key,
                sparse_mode=sparse_mode, return_lse=return_lse,
            )

    def execute_kv_quant_sparse_flash_attention(  # ← 公共命名风格，但仅供内部调用
        sfa_impl,
        ql_nope: torch.Tensor,
        q_pe: torch.Tensor,
        kv: torch.Tensor,
        block_table: torch.Tensor,
        topk_indices: torch.Tensor,
        actual_seq_lengths_query: torch.Tensor,
        actual_seq_lengths_key: torch.Tensor,
        *,
        sparse_mode: int = 3,
        return_lse: bool = False,
    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        query = torch.cat([ql_nope, q_pe], dim=-1).contiguous()
        result = torch_npu.npu_kv_quant_sparse_flash_attention(
            query=query, key=kv, value=kv,
            sparse_indices=topk_indices,
            scale_value=sfa_impl.scale,
            sparse_block_size=1,
            block_table=block_table,
            actual_seq_lengths_query=actual_seq_lengths_query,
            actual_seq_lengths_kv=actual_seq_lengths_key,
            layout_query="TND", layout_kv="PA_BSND",
            sparse_mode=sparse_mode, attention_mode=2,
            quant_scale_repo_mode=1,
            tile_size=getattr(sfa_impl, "sfa_qsfa_tile_size", 128),
            key_quant_mode=2, value_quant_mode=2,
            rope_head_dim=getattr(sfa_impl, "qk_rope_head_dim", q_pe.shape[-1]),
        )
        return result
